claims.text: Before the first dose, do a cardiovascular evaluation in triptan-naive patients with multiple CV risk factors (eg, older age, diabetes, HTN, smoking, obesity, strong family history of CAD); evidence of CAD or coronary vasospasm contraindicates it.
claims.quote: Perform a cardiovascular evaluation in triptan-naive patients who have multiple cardiovascular risk factors (e.g., increased age, diabetes, hypertension, smoking, obesity, strong family history of CAD) prior to receiving IMITREX injection. If there is evidence of CAD or coronary artery vasospasm, IMITREX injection is contraindicated
claims.locator: 5.1 Myocardial Ischemia, Myocardial Infarction, and Prinzmetal’s Angina

claims.text: Sumatriptan overdose: the half-life is about 2 hours, so monitor for at least 10 hours or while symptoms or signs persist.
claims.quote: The elimination half-life of sumatriptan is about 2 hours [see Clinical Pharmacology ( 12.3 )] ; therefore, monitoring of patients after overdose with IMITREX injection should continue for at least 10 hours or while symptoms or signs persist.
